perks.name: Smallbore

Balanced barrel.

  •  Greatly increases stability

  •  Increases airborne effectiveness

perks.name: Accurized Rounds

This weapon can fire longer distances.

perks.name: Light Mag
perks.desc:
Improved reload and range.
  •  Increases reload speed
  •  Slightly increases range

perks.name: Flared Magwell
perks.desc:
Optimized for fast reloading.
  •  Slightly increases stability
  •  Greatly increases reload speed

perks.name: Lead from Gold
perks.desc: Picking up Heavy ammo also grants ammo to this weapon.

perks.name: Sleight of Hand
perks.desc: Final blows with weapons or abilities while this weapon is stowed increase its handling, stability, and reload speed for a short duration.

perks.name: Slideshot
perks.desc: Sliding partially reloads this weapon's magazine and temporarily boosts range and stability.

perks.name: Grave Robber
perks.desc: Melee final blows or dealing damage with a charged melee reloads this weapon's magazine from reserves.

perks.name: Lone Wolf
perks.desc: Slightly improves aim assist, aim down sights speed, and airborne effectiveness. Increases these effects when there are no nearby allies.

perks.name: Proximity Power
perks.desc: When targets are nearby, final blows grant bonus Melee stat.

perks.name: Threat Detector
perks.desc: Increased reload, stability, and handling when enemies are in close proximity.

perks.name: Full Auto Trigger System
perks.desc: Holding down the trigger will fire this weapon at full auto.

perks.name: Firmly Planted
perks.desc: Increased accuracy, stability, and handling when firing while crouched.

perks.name: Field Prep
perks.desc: Increases ammo generation. Faster reload, stow, and ready speed when you're crouching.

perks.name: Pulse Monitor
perks.desc: Automatically reloads the magazine and improves weapon handling when wounded—even when this weapon is stowed.

perks.name: Closing Time
perks.desc: Improves range, accuracy, and handling as the magazine gets lower.

perks.name: Crystalline Corpsebloom
perks.desc: Rapid final blows spawn a [Stasis] Stasis crystal near the victim's location.

perks.name: Master of Arms
perks.desc: Kills with any weapon improve this weapon's damage for a short time.

perks.name: Chill Clip
perks.desc: Direct hits with the top half of the magazine cause a detonation that slows nearby targets.

perks.name: Discord
perks.desc: Final blows with another weapon grant this weapon increased speed for aiming down sights, accuracy, and airborne effectiveness for a short time. When Discord is active, final blows refund ammo.

perks.name: Binary Orbit
perks.desc: Elemental final blows opposite this weapon increase damage for a short duration. Darkness final blows boost Arc, Solar, and Void weapons. Light final blows boost Stasis, Strand, and Kinetic weapons.

perks.name: Opening Shot
perks.desc: Improved accuracy and range on the opening shot of attack.

perks.name: Eye of the Storm
perks.desc: This weapon becomes more accurate and boosts handling as your health gets lower.

perks.name: Demolitionist
perks.desc: Kills with this weapon generate grenade energy. Activating your grenade ability reloads this weapon from reserves.

perks.name: Surrounded
perks.desc: This weapon gains bonus damage when three or more enemies are in close proximity.

perks.name: One-Two Punch
perks.desc: Hitting an enemy with every pellet in a shot increases melee damage for a short duration.

perks.name: Hip-Fire Grip
perks.desc: Increases accuracy, stability, and precision hit targeting when firing from the hip.

perks.name: Field-Tested
perks.desc:
Defeating targets or dealing damage with this weapon gradually increases range, stability, handling, and reload speed.

Swords gain increased charge rate and guard resistance.

notes: Inspired by @Saint_Kabr, @CourtProjects and @ImpetusAlways (PvE PvE-Utility PvE-EndGame PvE-God M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE utility roll in both general at-level or better, and end-game underleveled content, particularly with Stasis builds. Hawthorne's Field-Forged Shotgun is now a lightweight shotgun, which are rated C-Tier for endgame PvE by @TheAegisRelic tiering spreadsheet https://linktr.ee/TheAegisRelic offering high QoL given its bonuses but an awful damage profile. The frame intrinsic offers +20 to Mobility and ×1.0625 base movement speed as per the https://www.destiny2.science/ Destiny Data Compendium. The stats are below average by comparison with its peers - hopefully when the website's back https://d2foundry.gg/w/3421075982 will show how the weapon stats impact in-game performance. Use the barrel perk to Handling or Range, or maybe tighten pellet spread, and then with the magazine perk you'll want something that improves magazine size, or Assault Mag improves RPM. As the damage profile isn't great, for end-game use, Chill Clip in the second trait perk column is the play to disrupt Overload Champions and control tougher adds, applying +60 stacks of Stasis Slow (freezing targets after 2 hits) within a 4m AoE for 4s on a hit - 8s with Whisper of Durance - with ammo in the top half of the base mag size. To help keep the mag topped out for Chill Clip, first column refill and reload perks like Slideshot, Grave Robber or Threadt Detector make sense. Alternatively Lead from Gold is always a top-tier perk, saving on Ammo Generation, Scavenger and Finder mods. The Field-Tested origin trait starts subtly but if you can stay alive to get kills, you'll start to feel the gunfeel stat boosts as you get to the higher stacks. Recommended MW: Handling, with your preferred choice of mod to boost weapon stats, ammo generation, or elemental pickups for builds - and don't forget to check any available seasonal fragile mods.

For a melee build, Proximity Power stacks up ×3 times to provide +15 (+18 enhanced) to your Melee attribute per stack on kills when another enemy's within 15m - a total a +45 (+54) for a refreshable 10s on further kills including those from Corpsebloom crystal shattering. The Field-Tested origin trait starts subtly but if you can stay alive to get kills, you'll start to feel the gunfeel stat boosts as you get to the higher stacks.
